ui.teamBridge.invitations.consent.bridge.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge Invitations view. A teammate added the reader's own AI agent (chief of staff) to a channel or group; the agent cannot join until its owner accepts. Accepting never unmutes the agent. The consent statement the owner agrees to by pressing Accept; the key names the participation version it is consent to (bridge_agent_participation_v1), so ANY change to this English text needs a new version and a new key. Keep both facts: from now on the agent can read the conversation's messages AND post there; it is woken only when someone @-mentions it. Do not say 'muted' (the app's Mute level means never notified).
